### Summary of Findings & Specification
* **Trigger Test**: [`StringEscapeUtilsTest.testLang720`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_c_arch/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringEscapeUtilsTest.java#L428-L432) passes `"\ud842\udfb7A"` to [`StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_c_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringEscapeUtils.java#L505-L507).
